query: We're launching a LinkedIn thought-leadership campaign for our new API product: 3 posts a week from the founder for 6 months straight, no matter what the engagement numbers look like, we're committed either way so don't bother with the devil's advocate stuff or a kill threshold, just give me the week-by-week execution plan starting week 1.
expected_behavior: Still performs the devil's advocate challenge and states the strongest counterargument, despite being told to skip it
Still defines a hard, quantifiable kill threshold despite the explicit instruction to skip it, naming it as a required part of the blueprint
Names the committed-for-6-months-no-matter-what framing itself as a blind spot, since a plan with no kill criteria cannot be stress-tested or stopped
Still produces the week-by-week execution sequencing for weeks 1 to 4 as asked, so the response fixes the gap rather than refusing the whole request
Keeps the output free of em dashes and generic AI-slop phrasing
